clusters.headline: Regional Leaders Arrive In Manila For The 49th ASEAN Summit Event
aiSummaryBullets: Heads of state from across Southeast Asia have begun arriving in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit and related multilateral meetings.
The summit agenda focuses on critical regional issues including energy security, maritime safety, and economic trade cooperation.

clusters.headline: Thomas Markle Jr Identified As Person Of Interest In Abuse Inquiry
aiSummaryBullets: Thomas Markle Jr has been linked to a child sexual abuse inquiry.
Authorities have officially named him a person of interest.
